_comment: Built-in pack for B.Sc. (26 October 2026), from the team's B.Sc. Wallah sample notes. It offers the typeset notes (note_studio/typeset), whose layout is the samples'. branding is printed on every page: header_left (also the notes' brand), header_right, footer_left, footer_right; audience is who the notes are written for. rules/ holds plain commands added after the engine's own prompt; edit them in Settings -> Categories.
label: B.Sc.
summary: B.Sc. Wallah typeset notes from a lecture PDF: coloured boxes, tables, labelled figures and Key Takeaways.
